y-m-73-07.material:
Isihloko sesihloko sithi "Ukukhuphuka Kwamanani Kuyehla Unyaka Wesibili Ulandelana". Inkomba yamanani abathengi (ne-2021 njenge-100; idatha eyenziwe) imi kanje. Funda ithebula ngokulandelana unyaka, inkomba yamanani, ukukhuphuka ngaphezu konyaka odlule. Ukukhuphuka kuzungezwa kudesimali eyodwa.

y-m-73-05.title: Ukukhetha kwabantu kungahluka noma amanani alindelekile efana?
y-m-73-05.goal: Chaza ukuthi noma amanani alindelekile efana, ukukhetha kungahluka kuye ngokuthi abantu bazizwa kanjani ngengozi yokulahlekelwa okukhulu, bese wenza imibandela yakho lapho ukuthenga i-inshuwalense kuyinzuzo encane kakhulu enanini elilindelekile.
y-m-73-05.material: Uma usebenzisa ifoni unyaka, isikrini sayo singaphuka. Njengecala elicatshangwayo, ithuba lokuphuka ngonyaka owodwa ngu-6% (cabanga ukuthi ingaphuka kanye ngonyaka kuphela), futhi uma iphuka, izindleko zokulungisa zingu-40만 원. I-inshuwalense yomonakalo ihlanganisa izindleko zokulungisa ezigcwele uma ukhokha inkokhelo yonyaka engu-2만 4천 원 (i-deductible engu-0 won). Cabanga ukuthi ithuba liyaziwa ngqo.

y-m-73-05.s.s1.prompt: Uma uqhathanisa ukuthenga i-inshuwalense nokungayithengi ngo-'nani elilindelekile lemali echithwe ngonyaka', yisiphi isihlolo esifaneleke kakhulu?
y-m-73-05.s.s1.hint.0: Bhala zonke izinombolo zokuchitha ezingenzeka ngonyaka ngaphandle kwe-inshuwalense, bese ubhala ithuba lalinye eceleni kwalo.
y-m-73-05.s.s1.hint.1: Thola isilinganiso salawo macala bese usiqhathanisa nenkokhelo, bese ucabanga ukuthi kuzophuma yimuphi umchitho ngempela uma ubheka unyaka owodwa kuphela.
y-m-73-05.s.s1.o.a: Amanani alindelekile ayafana, ngakho noma ukhetha yiliphi, imali oyichitha ngempela unyaka ngamunye ifana ngqo.
y-m-73-05.s.s1.r.a: Inani elilindelekile yisilinganiso ezikhathini eziningi. Uphuthelwe ukuthi ukuchitha kwangempela kunoma yimuphi unyaka kungahlukana kube ngu-0 won noma 40만 원.
y-m-73-05.s.s1.o.b: 6% ithuba elincane, ngakho umonakalo ngeke wenzeke, futhi ukuthenga i-inshuwalense kuyilahleko nje.
y-m-73-05.s.s1.r.b: Uguqule ithuba elincane lwaba 'angeke lenzeke'. Iphuzu lenkinga ukuthi noma kungu-6%, uma kwenzeka kubiza inani elikhulu.
y-m-73-05.s.s1.o.c: Inkokhelo incane kakhulu kunezindleko zokulungisa, ngakho ukuthenga i-inshuwalense kuyinzuzo ngaphandle kwemibandela.
y-m-73-05.s.s1.r.c: Uqhathanise kuphela osayizi benkokhelo nezindleko zokulungisa. Kufanele uphindaphinde ngethuba lokuthi kudingeka ukulungisa ukuze wenze ukuqhathanisa kwesilinganiso.
y-m-73-05.s.s1.o.d: Amanani alindelekile ayafana ngakho akukho okungcono, futhi okuhlukanisa ukhetho ukuthi ufuna ukugwema ingozi yezindleko ezinkulu yini.
y-m-73-05.s.s1.r.d: Uthole indinganiso esala uma amanani alindelekile efana (ukuthi ungakwazi ukuthwala ingozi engakanani).
y-m-73-05.s.s1.explain: Ngaphandle kwe-inshuwalense, izindleko zokulungisa ezilindelekile zingu-0.06 × 40만 = 2만 4천 원, ezifanayo nenkokhelo. Ngokwesilinganiso akukho okungcono, kodwa ngaphandle kwe-inshuwalense kunethuba elingu-6% lokuthi 40만 원 ivele yonke ngesikhathi esisodwa. Ukuthi umuntu ufuna ukugwema le ngozi kangakanani kuncike kumuntu nesimo.

y-m-73-03.title: Isihloko sezindaba esithi isilinganiso singu-500만 원
y-m-73-03.goal: Qaphela ukuthi isilinganiso sodwa asikwazi ukusetshenziswa ukuhlulela isitatimende esithi 'okungenani uhhafu uthola ngaphezulu kwenani elithile', sho ukuthi yimuphi ulwazi olwengeziwe oludingekayo, bese wenza idatha yakho enesilinganiso esifanayo kodwa iziphetho ezihlukile.

Isihloko esisodwa sezindaba sithi 'Isilinganiso semali engenayo yenyanga yemizi kulo mzana (ngaphambi kwamathelekisi, iyunithi: 만 원) singu-500', futhi umusho wokugcina wesihloko esifanayo uthi 'Okungenani uhhafu wemizi kulo mzana uthola ngaphezu kuka-400만 원 ngenyanga.' Imali engenayo yomuzi ngamunye ayinikezwanga esihlokweni. Imali engenayo yenyanga yomuzi ngamunye ingu-100만 원 okungenani, futhi imali engenayo iyizinombolo ezigcwele (ngamayunithi ka-만 원).

y-m-73-03.s.s2.because.model.0: Noma isilinganiso singu-500, uma umuzi owodwa uphezulu kakhulu, njengo-1500, eminye ingaba phansi. Esibonelweni esingenhla, isilinganiso singu-500 kodwa umuzi ophakathi ungu-300. Ngakho isilinganiso sodwa asikwazi ukusho ukuthi uhhafu uthola ngaphezu kuka-400 yini.
y-m-73-03.s.s2.because.model.1: Uma imali engenayo yeminye imizi inkulu kakhulu, isilinganiso siyadonswa phezulu. Isilinganiso singu-500, kodwa imizi emi-4 kwemi-5 ingaba ku-400 noma ngaphansi. Ukuhlulela ngesilinganiso kuphela akwanele; kufanele ubheke nenani eliphakathi.
y-m-73-03.s.s2.because.modelNote.1: Ayikhulumi ngecala lapho kuyiqiniso, kodwa ihlangabezana neqhaza eliyinhloko

y-m-73-02.prereq.3: Ilebula ye-H3 kulo msebenzi ingophawu lobunzima kuphela lwalesi sethi sokukhiqiza; akusho ukuthi ikharikhulamu yabela lokhu okuqukethwe ibanga elithile. Umcabango: umfundi ohlangana nezibalo zomnotho ngezinga lesikole esiphakeme okokuqala.
y-m-73-02.title: Ingabe indawo enezindleko eziphansi kunazo zonke ngento ngayinye iyindawo enenzuzo enkulu?
y-m-73-02.goal: Hlola ukuthi inani lokukhiqiza elinezindleko eziphakathi eziphansi kunazo zonke ngento ngayinye nelinenzuzo enkulu lingahluka, uguqule isinqumo sakho njengoba iphuzu ngalinye lolwazi lwentengo linikezwa.
y-m-73-02.material:
Indawo yokusebenza yensipho enziwe ngezandla yenza izinto ezingu-q (inombolo eqondile) ngenyanga futhi yithengise zonke. Izindleko eziphelele zenyanga eyodwa ngu-C(q) = 50 + 10q + q² (iyunithi: 천 원). Kulokhu, u-50 uyisindleko esihleliwe, esikhokhwa nyanga zonke noma ngabe akukho nento eyodwa eyenziwe. Inzuzo = intengo yokuthengisa × q − C(q). Izindleko eziphakathi ngento ngayinye ngu-C(q) ÷ q. (q² ifundwa ngokuthi 'q squared'.)

Isilinganiso sokukhiqiza q (izinto) | Izindleko eziphelele (천 원) | Izindleko eziphakathi ngento ngayinye (천 원)
1 | 61 | 61.00
3 | 89 | 29.67
5 | 125 | 25.00
7 | 169 | 24.14
8 | 194 | 24.25
10 | 250 | 25.00
15 | 425 | 28.33
20 | 650 | 32.50

(Funda ithebula ngokulandelana q, izindleko eziphelele, izindleko eziphakathi. Phakathi kwamanani aqondile ka-q, izindleko eziphakathi eziphansi kunazo zonke zingu-q=7.)
y-m-73-02.prereq.2: Ukuhlukanisa inani eliphakathi (ngento ngayinye) nenani eliphelele
y-m-73-02.s.s1.prompt: Ulwazi lwentengo luzovezwa kunye ngesikhathi. Esinyathelweni ngasinye, khetha isinqumo esifaneleke kakhulu okwamanje.
y-m-73-02.s.s1.hint.0: Esinyathelweni ngasinye, qala ubhale ukuthi yiziphi izinombolo ozaziyo manje nokuthi yiziphi ongakazazi.
y-m-73-02.s.s1.hint.1: Khetha izinombolo ezimbili noma ezintathu bese uziqhathanisa ngqo ukuhlola ukuthi isinqumo osikhethile siyavumelana yini nezinombolo zenzuzo ezivezwe.
y-m-73-02.s.s1.st.0.info: Uyazi ithebula elingenhla kuphela. Awukayazi intengo yokuthengisa ngento ngayinye.
y-m-73-02.s.s1.st.0.ask: Singasho ukuthi 'inzuzo inkulu kakhulu uma kwenziwa izinto ezingu-7, lapho izindleko eziphakathi ziphansi kunazo zonke'?
y-m-73-02.s.s1.st.0.after: Inzuzo incike entengweni yokuthengisa, ngakho ithebula lezindleko lodwa alikwazi ukukutshela ukuthi yiliphi inani lokukhiqiza elinikeza inzuzo enkulu. Okwamanje, 'ukumisa isinqumo' kuyimpendulo esekelwe kahle kakhulu.
y-m-73-02.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Yebo. Ku-7 izinto, lapho izindleko ngento ngayinye ziphansi kunazo zonke, inzuzo nayo inkulu kunazo zonke.
y-m-73-02.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Uxhumanise izindleko eziphansi ngqo nenzuzo ephezulu. Inzuzo incike nasentengweni yokuthengisa, ngakho ayikwazi ukuqinisekiswa ngethebula lezindleko lodwa.
y-m-73-02.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Ngaphandle kokwazi intengo yokudayisa awukwazi ukubala inzuzo, ngakho kusenesikhathi sokuhlulela manje.
y-m-73-02.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Awukhohlwanga ukuthi inzuzo ngumehluko phakathi kwemali engenayo nezindleko. Ukhombisile ukuthi yimuphi ulwazi olwengeziwe oludingeka ukwaziwa.
y-m-73-02.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Uma wenza izinto ezimbalwa ngaphansi kuka-7, izindleko zento ngayinye ziyancipha, ngakho inzuzo iba nkulu.
y-m-73-02.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Ethebuleni, imikhiqizo ephansi (izinto ezi-5, izinto ezi-3) empeleni inezindleko eziphezulu zento ngayinye. Udinga ukuhlola futhi ukuthi ufunda kanjani ithebula.
y-m-73-02.s.s1.st.1.info: Intengo yokudayisa yento ngayinye isiyaziwa ukuthi ingu-40 (천 원). Ukubala inzuzo = 40q − C(q), inzuzo ingu-111 uma q=7, 150 uma q=10, 175 uma q=15, 150 uma q=20, futhi 75 uma q=25.
y-m-73-02.s.s1.st.1.ask: Wawuzohlulela kanjani manje? (Ngaphakathi kwemikhiqizo ekhonjiswe ethebuleni)
y-m-73-02.s.s1.st.1.after: Uma intengo yokudayisa iphezulu kakhulu kuneyezindleko ezijwayelekile ezingu-24.14, khona-ke uma wenza izinto ezingaphezu kwezi-7, imali engenayo engeziwe inkulu kunezindleko ezengeziwe, ngakho inzuzo iyakhula kakhulu. Inzuzo inkulu kakhulu ezintweni ezingu-15 ne-175 (kubalwa izinombolo ezigcwele), bese iyancipha.
y-m-73-02.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Inzuzo inkulu uma kwenziwa izinto ezi-7, lapho izindleko ezijwayelekile ziphansi kakhulu.
y-m-73-02.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Amanani amakhulu kuno-111 wezinto ezi-7 avela ezintweni ezingu-10 (150) nezintweni ezingu-15 (175). Qhathanisa nezinombolo osanda kuzihlola.
y-m-73-02.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Uma wenza izinto eziningi, inzuzo iqhubeka ikhula.
y-m-73-02.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Ubheka izinto ezingu-20 (150) nezinto ezingu-25 (75), kusukela endaweni ethile inzuzo iyancipha. Lesi sinqumo asizange sifunde ithebula kuze kube sekugcineni.
y-m-73-02.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Ukwenza izinto ezingaphezu kwezi-7 kunika inzuzo enkulu, futhi izinto ezingu-15 zinkulu kakhulu.
y-m-73-02.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Uqhathanise izinombolo zenzuzo ngqo futhi wafunda ukuthi izindleko ezijwayelekile eziphansi kakhulu nenzuzo enkulu kakhulu kungahluka.
y-m-73-02.s.s1.st.2.info: Ukuncintisana sekukhulile futhi intengo yokudayisa yento ngayinye yehlele ku-24 (천 원). Izindleko ezimisiwe ezingu-50 zisakhokhwa kulo nyanga noma ukukhiqiza kumiswa. Inzuzo = 24q − C(q): −50 uma q=0, −5 uma q=5, −2 uma q=6, −1 uma q=7, −2 uma q=8, futhi −10 uma q=10.
y-m-73-02.s.s1.st.2.ask: Kule ntengo, yisiphi isinqumo esifaneleke kakhulu sohlelo lokukhiqiza lwale nyanga?
y-m-73-02.s.s1.st.2.after: Ngentengo engu-24, wonke umkhiqizo uyilahleko. Kodwa izindleko ezimisiwe ezingu-50 zikhokhwa noma kunjalo, ngakho −1 ezintweni ezi-7 kungcono kakhulu kuno-−50 ezintweni ezingu-0. (Uma izindleko ezimisiwe zingagwenywa, isinqumo besizoshintsha, kodwa kule nkinga sicabange ukuthi azigwenywa.)
y-m-73-02.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Kuyilahleko, kodwa ilahleko incane kakhulu ezintweni ezi-7, ngakho kungcono ukuzenza.
y-m-73-02.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Uhlanganise ekuqhathaniseni umbandela wokuthi izindleko ezimisiwe zikhokhwa noma wenza noma ungenzi lutho. Lokhu kuhlukile esinqumweni esishiya izindleko ezimisiwe.
y-m-73-02.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Wonke umkhiqizo uyilahleko, ngakho kungcono ukungenzi nento eyodwa.
y-m-73-02.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Lesi sinqumo sishiye u-−50 wokungenzi lutho. Ngaphansi kombandela wokuthi izindleko ezimisiwe zikhokhwa noma kunjalo, qhathanisa nenzuzo ezintweni ezingu-0 nayo.
y-m-73-02.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Uma wenza izinto ezi-7, lapho izindleko ezijwayelekile ziphansi kakhulu, lo nyanga uzoba nenzuzo.
y-m-73-02.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Uphuthelwe ukuthi izindleko ezijwayelekile ezingu-24.14 zinkulu kuneyentengo yokudayisa engu-24. Noma izindleko ezijwayelekile eziphansi kakhulu ziphezulu kuneyentengo.
y-m-73-02.s.s1.reflect: Buyekeza izinqumo zakho ezintathu. Kwakungesikhathi sini lapho umkhiqizo onezindleko ezijwayelekile eziphansi kakhulu wawufana nomkhiqizo onenzuzo enkulu kakhulu? Uma intengo yokudayisa ishintsha, umkhiqizo onenzuzo enkulu kakhulu washintsha kanjani?
y-m-73-02.s.s2.prompt: Uma intengo yokudayisa ingu-40 (천 원), faka imikhiqizo emi-3 ehlukile q lapho inzuzo inkulu kuneyokwenza izinto ezi-7, lapho izindleko ezijwayelekile ziphansi kakhulu. (q iyinombolo ephelele kusukela ku-1 kuya ku-30)
y-m-73-02.s.s2.hint.0: Khetha amanani ambalwa ka-q anjenge-7, 10, 20, 25, bala inzuzo, uyiqhathanise no-111, bese uyihlela etafuleni.
y-m-73-02.s.s2.hint.1: Ukuthola lapho iqala ukudlula u-111 nalapho iwela ngaphansi futhi, shintsha q elilodwa ngelilodwa uhlole imikhawulo.
y-m-73-02.s.s2.ok.c1: Iyinombolo ephelele kusukela ku-1 kuya ku-30.
y-m-73-02.s.s2.fail.c1: q kufanele ibe yinombolo ephelele kusukela ku-1 kuya ku-30.
y-m-73-02.s.s2.fail.c2: Inzuzo ayinkulu kuno-111. Bala 40q − C(q) bese uyiqhathanisa no-111 ezintweni ezi-7.
y-m-73-02.s.s2.explain: Inzuzo ingu-−q² + 30q − 50, ngakho inkulu kuno-111 ku-q=8 kuya ku-22. Isibonelo: q=8 inika 126, 10 inika 150, 15 inika 175, no-22 inika 126. q=23 inika 111, okulinganayo, futhi 25 inika 75, okuncane kunezintweni ezi-7. Inzuzo enkulu kakhulu ezintweni ezingu-15 (175).
y-m-73-02.s.s2.because.prompt: Usebenzisa izinombolo, chaza ukuthi kungani, uma intengo yokudayisa ingu-40, izinto ezi-7 ezinezindleko ezijwayelekile eziphansi kakhulu zingesona umkhiqizo onenzuzo enkulu kakhulu.
y-m-73-02.s.s2.because.hint.0: Beka izinto ezi-7 nezinto ezingu-10 eceleni komunye nomunye ethebuleni lenzuzo bese ubheka ukuthi umehluko phakathi kwenzuzo ezimbili uvela kuphi.
y-m-73-02.s.s2.because.hint.1: Bala ngokwehlukana izindleko ezengeziwe nemali engenayo engeziwe uma usuka ezintweni ezi-7 uye ezi-8, bese uziqhathanisa.

y-m-73-02.s.s2.because.selfAssess.2: Ingabe ucabange ngeqiniso lokuthi isiphetho singashintsha uma intengo yokudayisa ishintsha?

Uma intengo yokudayisa ingu-40, izindleko ezengeziwe ezivela kuyo yesi-8 ngaphezu kwezi-7 (cishe 25) zincane kuno-40, ngakho uma wenza okuningi, inzuzo ikhula. Empeleni, izinto ezi-7 zinika u-111 futhi izinto ezingu-15 zinika u-175.
y-m-73-02.s.s2.because.model.1: Intengo ingu-40, ehluke kakhulu ezindlekweni ezijwayelekile ezingu-24.14. Inqobo nje uma izindleko ezengeziwe zokwandisa inani lezinto zincane kuneyentengo engu-40, ukwenza okuningi kunika inzuzo enkulu. Izinto ezingu-10 zinika u-150, okukhulu kuno-111 wezinto ezi-7.

y-m-73-01.title: Uma inyuka ngo-50% bese yehla ngo-50%
y-m-73-01.topic: Ukusebenzisa izinguquko zamaphesenti eyodwa ngemva kweyodwa
y-m-73-01.goal: Usebenzisa iqiniso lokuthi inguquko ngayinye yephesenti isekelwe enanini elingaphambi kwayo ngqo, thola iphutha esixazululweni esengeze amaphesenti kuphela, bese wakha wena inhlanganisela yokukhuphuka nokwehla ebuyela enanini lokuqala.
y-m-73-01.material: Inani lansuku zonke labahambeli besitolo se-inthanethi likhuphuke ngo-50% kusuka enanini lokuqala ngoJanuwari, bese lehla ngo-50% kusuka enanini likaJanuwari ngoFebhuwari. Zonke izinguquko zamaphesenti zisekelwe enanini labahambeli 'enyangeni ngaphambi kwayo ngqo'. Thatha inani lokuqala labahambeli libe ngu-100, futhi uphathe imiphumela njengamanani ethiyori lapho amadesimali evunyelwe. Ngezansi kukhona isixazululo somfundi oyedwa.
y-m-73-01.thinking.1: Ukwazi ukuthi uma isisekelo sishintsha, iphesenti elifanayo liba yinani elihlukile
y-m-73-01.prereq.0: Ukubala ukukhuphuka nokwehla kwamaphesenti ngokuphindaphinda (izinga lesikole esiphakathi)
y-m-73-01.prereq.2: Ilebula ye-H3 kulo msebenzi ingophawu lobunzima kuphela lwalesi sethi sokukhiqiza; akusho ukuthi ikharikhulamu yabela lokhu okuqukethwe ibanga elithile. Umcabango: umfundi ohlangana nezibalo zomnotho ngezinga lesikole esiphakeme okokuqala.
y-m-73-01.s.s1.prompt: Khetha umugqa owodwa ongalungile kulesi sixazululo.
y-m-73-01.s.s1.hint.0: Emugqeni ngamunye, bhala ukuthi uthi bangaki abahambeli, bese uthola imigqa emibili enikeza izinombolo ezihlukile zenyanga efanayo.
y-m-73-01.s.s1.hint.1: Hlola emugqeni 2 nomugqa 3 ukuthi u-+50% no-−50% ngamunye ungu-50% wenombolo ephi.
y-m-73-01.s.s1.line.0: Thatha inani lokuqala labahambeli libe ngu-100.
y-m-73-01.s.s1.line.1: NgoJanuwari: abahambeli abangu-100 bakhuphuka ngo-50% baba ngu-150.
y-m-73-01.s.s1.line.2: NgoFebhuwari: abahambeli abangu-150 bahla ngo-50% baba ngu-75.
y-m-73-01.s.s1.line.3: Njengoba u-+50% no-−50% ahlanganisa ku-0%, inani labahambeli ngoFebhuwari lingu-100, elifana nelokuqala.
y-m-73-01.s.s1.line.4: Ngakho inani labahambeli alizange lishintshe phezu kwezinyanga ezimbili.
y-m-73-01.s.s1.explain: Umugqa 3 usunikeza abahambeli abangu-75 ngoFebhuwari, kodwa umugqa 4 uthi u-100, ngakho awavumelani. U-+50% no-−50% emugqeni 4 anezisekelo ezihlukile (owokuqala usekelwe ku-100, owesibili ku-150). Amaphesenti angahlanganiswa futhi akhishwe kuphela uma enesisekelo esifanayo. Ngakho umugqa 4 awulungile, futhi umugqa 5, owakhiwe kuwo, awulungile nawo.
y-m-73-01.s.s2.prompt: Yakha izinhlanganisela ezibuyela ncamashi enanini lokuqala. Faka amapheya angu-2 ahlukene (p, q) ukuze inani likhuphuke ngo-p% enyangeni yokuqala bese lehla ngo-q% (ngokusekelwe enanini ngaleso sikhathi) enyangeni elandelayo, ukuze ngemva kwezinyanga ezimbili lifane ncamashi nelokuqala. p iyinombolo eqondile kusuka ku-1 kuya ku-500, no-q iyinombolo eqondile kusuka ku-1 kuya ku-99.
y-m-73-01.s.s2.hint.0: Khetha u-p, thola inani ngemva kwenyanga yokuqala, bese uzama wena ukuthi yiliphi iphesenti okumele ulinciphise kulo ukuze ubuyele ku-100.
y-m-73-01.s.s2.hint.1: Zama ukuthi p no-q bangafana yini, futhi uma kungenjalo, qhathanisa ukuthi q inkulu noma incane kuno-p.
y-m-73-01.s.s2.fail.c1: p kumele ibe yinombolo eqondile kusuka ku-1 kuya ku-500, futhi q kumele ibe yinombolo eqondile kusuka ku-1 kuya ku-99.
y-m-73-01.s.s2.ok.c2: Inani ngemva kwezinyanga ezimbili lifana nelokuqala.
y-m-73-01.s.s2.fail.c2: Inani ngemva kwezinyanga ezimbili lihlukile kulelo lokuqala. Qala uthole inani ngemva kwenyanga yokuqala, bese uhlola inani olitholayo ngokunciphisa u-q% kulo.
y-m-73-01.s.s2.explain: Izibonelo: Uma likhuphuka ngo-25% liba ngu-125, futhi njengoba u-20% ka-125 ungu-25, ukunciphisa u-20% kunikeza u-100. Uma likhuphuka ngo-100% liba ngu-200, futhi ukunciphisa u-50% kunikeza u-100; uma likhuphuka ngo-150% liba ngu-250, futhi ukunciphisa u-60% kunikeza u-100. (300, 75) no-(400, 80) nakho kuyasebenza. Ngenxa yokuthi inani ngemva kokukhuphuka likhulu, iphesenti lokunciphisa elidingekayo ukubuya lihlala lincane kunephesenti lokukhuphuka.
y-m-73-01.s.s2.because.prompt: Usebenzisa inombolo eyodwa, chaza ukuthi kungani p no-q bengalingani ezinhlanganisela owazenza.
y-m-73-01.s.s2.because.hint.0: Khetha eyodwa yezinhlanganisela owazenza ngenhla, bese uqala ubhale inani ngemva kwenyanga yokuqala.
y-m-73-01.s.s2.because.hint.1: Thola ukuthi q% walelo nani uyini, bese uqhathanisa no-q% wenani lokuqala.
y-m-73-01.s.s2.because.placeholder: Isibonelo: Isisekelo sephesenti lokunciphisa kusuka ku-125 ngu-...
y-m-73-01.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ingabe usebenzise echazweni iqiniso lokuthi inani ngemva kwenyanga yokuqala lihlukile kulelo lokuqala?
y-m-73-01.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ingabe uchaze ngokucacile ukuthi isisekelo sephesenti lokunciphisa siyini?
y-m-73-01.s.s2.because.selfAssess.2: Ingabe ubale wena izinombolo osebenzise zona futhi wahlola ukuthi zilungile?
y-m-73-01.s.s2.because.model.0: Inani ngemva kokukhuphuka liba likhulu kuno-100, ngakho isisekelo sephesenti lokunciphisa siyashintsha. Uma unciphisa u-25% wenani elingu-125 elavela ekukhuphukeni okungu-25%, uthola u-93.75, ngakho alibuyi; kumele unciphise u-20%, okungu-25, ukuze uthole u-100.
y-m-73-01.s.s2.because.model.1: Enyangeni yokuqala isisekelo singu-100, futhi enyangeni yesibili isisekelo siyinani elikhulu u-150. Noma kungu-50% ofanayo, inani elinciphisiwe likhulu ku-75, ngakho iphesenti lokunciphisa elidingekayo ukubuya lingaba lincane, njengoba isibonelo (150%, 60%) sibonisa.
y-m-73-01.s.s2.because.model.2: Uma p=25 no-q=20, ukunciphisa u-125 ngo-20% kususa u-25, okuyibuyisela ku-100. U-25% ka-125 ungu-31.25, ngakho ukusetha q ibe ngu-25 kunciphisa kakhulu.
